q: Who do I call if LedgerOne is down?

body.answer_text: If LedgerOne is down, first escalate to the payments ops duty manager [1]. Then, call the LedgerOne vendor hotline if the outage lasts more than 30 minutes [1].

memory.text: On-call escalation: payments ops duty manager first, then the LedgerOne vendor hotline if the outage lasts more than 30 minutes.

sources.transcript: On-call escalation goes to the payments ops duty manager first, then to the LedgerOne vendor hotline if it's still down after thirty minutes. The hotline is useless before then.

memory.text: The LedgerOne reconciliation report is wrong on the first business day of each month because of a timezone bug. Rerun it after 10 a.m. Eastern.

sources.transcript: The reconciliation report from LedgerOne is always wrong on the first business day of the month, because of a timezone bug. Rerun it after ten a.m. Eastern and it comes out right.
